theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · constructor; assumption
  intro s1 s2 r μ
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := h
    cases htr
    case choiceL htr =>
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
      · constructor; apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
    case choiceR htr =>
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · apply Tr.choiceR htr
      · constructor; apply HomBisimilarity.refl
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := h
    cases htr
    case choiceL htr =>
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
      · constructor; apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
    case choiceR htr =>
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · apply Tr.choiceR htr
      · constructor; apply HomBisimilarity.refl
